text:
devon: Heads-up — PR eval queue is spiking again, causing >2h waits for small quantization PRs. Can we try staggered PR buckets for GHA to smooth the thundering herd?

maria: ugh, yep saw this. Nightly still fine. PRs cluster around merges. current workaround is agents limit but it's killing throughput.

kevin: idea: add a small random jitter + matrix bucket step so GH Actions spawns N buckets and we only allow X concurrent per bucket. reduces concurrency bursts.

sarah: would also prefer prioritizing smaller evals (smoke) for PRs and defer full evals to scheduled job. Probably add `label: eval:quick` or `eval:full` to switch.

devon: prototype YAML i used locally:

```yaml
name: eval-pr
on: [pull_request]
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.ref }}-eval
  cancel-in-progress: false
strategy:
  matrix:
    bucket: [1,2,3,4] # staggered windows
jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: delay
        run: sleep $(( (matrix.bucket - 1) * 30 + RANDOM % 20 ))
      - name: run smoke eval
        run: ./tools/run_eval --mode smoke
```

maria: nice, sleep jitter + buckets. we should make buckets per repo to avoid cross-repo stacking. also set `concurrency: group: eval-${{ github.repository }}` so different repos don't fight.

gha-bot: [system] Job queued: eval-pr (bucket 2) for PR #1428

kevin: buildkite side: we can do a `pipeline` run to accept pre-sliced shards, use `buildkite-agent pipeline upload` and tag artifacts with `eval-bucket=2`. Then runners can filter with `BUCKET==2` env in agent meta-data. Example: `buildkite-agent meta-data get eval-bucket`

sarah: +1. Also need to update the runner self-hosted pool autoscale policy to keep some spare capacity for smoke jobs. Otherwise queued smoke still waits.

devon: next steps: (1) land GHA matrix change in a small repo, (2) add label-based quick/full switch, (3) update buildkite runner filters, (4) monitor token-level latency in console. I'll open a PR with YAML and a short rollout doc.

maria: assign me to the PR review. Also can we add a simple dashboard panel: "PR eval queue depth by bucket" and a burn-down chart?

devon: yep will add a prometheus counter `eval_pr_queue{bucket}` and push to console metrics.

kevin: if we see cross-model regression because of batching, let's add a canary rule to route a small % to hosted fallback. Not for initial rollout but keep in runbook.

sarah: runbook: if queue depth > 300 for >15m:
- pause full eval PR triggers
- increase smoke concurrency
- escalate to eng-infra

devon: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll post the PR link when ready.
